params.body:
## Summary
- Settings > Website gets a "Publieke API" block below the Iframe url field (`v1/public/*`, `dealers.public_api_token`, previously only settable via `tinker`): no token shows one sentence plus a "Token aanmaken" button; a token shows it masked (`•••• ` + last 4 chars, with a green "ingesteld" chip matching the rest of the tab) with Tonen / Kopiëren / Vernieuwen, the API base url, and a link to `/docs` when Scribe's static docs are published.
- Two new POST routes, `settings.api_token.reveal` and `settings.api_token.rotate`, both gated on the `website.index` right (the same right that shows the tab) and both logged (`[PublicApiToken] revealed|rotated`, dealer + user id). Rotate always generates a fresh `Str::random(64)` token; the old one stops authenticating immediately since `AuthenticatePublicApi` looks the token up by value. "Vernieuwen" asks for confirmation first, naming that the old token stops working at once.
- `SettingsController::maskApiToken()` is the one place that formats the masked display, used both server-side (initial render) and returned in the rotate response (so the field updates without a reload).
- `.ui-copy-link-actions` gets `flex-wrap: wrap` (base + mobile) so a third action button (this block has three: Tonen/Kopiëren/Vernieuwen, versus the existing two-button iframe-url pattern) drops to its own row on a phone instead of running past the edge of the screen; the existing two-button case is unaffected.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "Settings|PublicApi|Api|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|CompiledViews|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|StylesheetSyntax"` — 136 passed, including the new `SettingsApiTokenTest` (rotate/reveal require the right, rotate returns a 64-char token with the correct mask, rotate invalidates the old token on the public API and the new one works).
- [x] Manually exercised the full flow in the browser at 1440px and 390px: create, reveal, copy, the "Vernieuwen" confirm dialog, and the mobile button wrap.
params.title: The public API token is managed on the Website tab
